reference_sql:
SELECT a.segment,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'monthly') AS monthly_subs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.billing_period = 'annual') AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment
alternatives:
SELECT segment, monthly AS monthly_subs, annual AS annual_subs
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription running on 31 December 2025
  SELECT a.segment, s.billing_period
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
) AS r
PIVOT (COUNT(*) FOR billing_period IN ('monthly', 'annual') GROUP BY segment)

SELECT a.segment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.billing_period = 'monthly' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_subs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.billing_period = 'annual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS annual_subs
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = s.account_id
WHERE s.start_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date > DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY a.segment
